h1: Newtown Square travel, stays & events guide
heroText: Newtown Square, on the Philadelphia Main Line, has Aronimink Golf Club, the Newtown Square Historic District and Drexel Lodge Park, and this page also covers Ridley Creek State Park and the Wayne Art Center. The township is first mentioned in 1684, and Old St. David's Church dates from 1715.

history.text: The first mention of the township was in 1684, when Thomas Norbury and John Humphrey were appointed collectors of the "Levie for the cort house and Prison for ye Township of Newtowne".

source.label: Wikipedia: Newtown Township, Delaware County, Pennsylvania

history.text: As such, in 1687, an east–west road was laid out (Goshen Road) so the Friends could attend either Goshen or the Haverford Friends Meeting.

source.label: Wikipedia: Newtown Township, Delaware County, Pennsylvania

history.text: By 1696, these friends had become numerous enough to hold their own meeting in Newtown and continued to meet in a private home until the completion of the Newtown Square Friends Meetinghouse in 1711.

source.label: Wikipedia: Newtown Township, Delaware County, Pennsylvania

history.text: Old St. David's Church (1715) – the oldest non-Quaker church in Delaware County, founded by Welsh Anglicans; burial place of General "Mad" Anthony Wayne, located on S. Valley Forge Road in the very corner of the Township.

source.label: Wikipedia: Newtown Township, Delaware County, Pennsylvania

history.text: By 1889, the reorganized Philadelphia and West Chester Traction Company had completed the track to West Chester.

source.label: Wikipedia: Newtown Township, Delaware County, Pennsylvania

history.text: In 1894, however, a mule-drawn service was initiated by the Philadelphia and Delaware County Railroad, with steam dummies used to help out on the hills.

source.label: Wikipedia: Newtown Township, Delaware County, Pennsylvania
